policy.ordering: Lowest id first within the current release, with every blockedBy done. Release order is deliberate: R1 proves the colour engine in public before anything is built on top of it.

features.title: Monorepo toolchain scaffold
acceptance: pnpm workspace with apps/*, packages/*, tests/* resolves and installs
Turborepo pipeline runs typecheck, lint, format:check, test, build across the workspace
TypeScript project references configured; tsconfig.json is the lint/editor project and tsconfig.build.json is the emit project
Package boundary lint fails on a deep import into another package's internals
The colour-engine lint zone fails on node:*, window, document or process
Gates 1-4 and 6 activate in gates.json and run in CI
features.notes: Node 24 LTS is pinned in .nvmrc. The workstation currently runs 22.16.0 and must be upgraded before this feature starts.

features.title: Shared contracts package
acceptance: Zod schemas are the single source of runtime validation, TypeScript types and OpenAPI
A schema change propagates to inferred types with no hand-written duplicate
The error-code enum is closed and versioned
No hand-written type duplicates a schema

features.title: OKLCH-native design token package
acceptance: design-system.manifest.json compiles to CSS custom properties, TypeScript, React Native styles and a Tailwind v4 theme
The contrast gate reads the manifest and checks every pairsWith combination in both themes
Every status token pairs with an icon token; a status expressible only as colour cannot be constructed
cvdPairs are asserted distinguishable at severity 1.0
Gate 9 (contrast) activates, report-only while the manifest status is placeholder
features.notes: Concrete values arrive from the design deliverable. The structure and the pipeline land here.

features.title: CI/CD pipeline and gate wiring
acceptance: GitHub Actions runs every active gate in gates.json order, stopping at the first failure
The gates.json to ci.yml mirror check passes, and a deliberately removed step makes it fail
Branch protection requires all checks, one review, and linear history
gitleaks runs on every push; dependency audit blocks on Critical and High
Changesets configured for the publishable packages

features.title: Deployment profiles: local, VPS, cloud
acceptance: Multi-stage Dockerfiles for api, worker and web; non-root, pinned base digests
infra/compose/docker-compose.prod.yml boots the full stack and is consumed unmodified by both Coolify and Dokploy
/healthz checks the process only; /readyz checks database and cache
Migrations run at boot under a Postgres advisory lock; simultaneous container starts do not race
Every infrastructure dependency sits behind a port with a conformance suite every adapter passes
The stack is deployed and verified on a real VPS through Coolify AND through Dokploy
Terraform skeleton for the cloud profile exists with remote state configured
features.notes: The deployment story is R0, not R4. Retrofitted after twenty features it becomes a rewrite.

features.title: Colour spaces and conversion
acceptance: sRGB, Display-P3, linear RGB, CIE XYZ (D65), CIELAB, CIELCh, OKLab and OKLCh conversions implemented
CAT16 chromatic adaptation, with Bradford available
Golden datasets from published sources, each citing its source, including near-black values that fail against a pure-power transfer function
Round-trip through every pair within DeltaE00 0.01 across 10,000 sampled colours
Cross-platform identity: Node, browser and React Native produce bitwise-identical output
Zero runtime dependencies; no node:*, DOM or process
Gate 5 (color-golden) activates

features.title: Colour difference and contrast
acceptance: DeltaE76, DeltaE94, DeltaE00 (CIEDE2000) and DeltaEok implemented
All 34 Sharma-Wu-Dalal test pairs reproduced to 4 decimal places
WCAG 2.x contrast ratio matches the specification's worked examples exactly
APCA Lc computed and reported alongside
Property tests assert DeltaE symmetry and identity

features.title: CVD engine and separation scoring
acceptance: Brettel-Vienot dichromacy and Machado anomalous trichromacy at severity 0 to 1
Dichromat simulation of a published confusion-line pair yields DeltaE00 below 2
One separation score in [0,100], combining post-simulation DeltaE00 with lightness difference, used identically by the UI and the recommendation engine
Gate 10 (cvd) activates

features.title: Gamut mapping
acceptance: Out-of-gamut colours map by OKLCh chroma reduction, preserving lightness and hue within stated bounds
Mapping an in-gamut colour is idempotent, asserted by property test
Golden set of known out-of-gamut colours and their mapped results

features.title: The Color value type and reproducibility envelope
acceptance: Color carries required Provenance; an unclassified colour is not constructible
Provenance records source, confidence, conditions and originSpace
Color.unsafeFromHex is the only untracked construction path, and every call site is reviewed
Every derived result carries {engine, corpus, rules, profile}
A regression test pins historical envelopes and replays them byte-identically

features.title: Corpus schema, provenance and the content gate
acceptance: Entry schema per docs/content/color-corpus-spec.md, with all provenance fields required
Five classifications enforced and displayed; our own curation cannot be marked historical
Derived values (lab, oklch, hex) computed from xyz by the engine at build time, never typed
Editorial workflow draft to review to verified to published to superseded; author and reviewer must differ
Corpus versions immutable once published, with checksums verified at load
Gate 11 (content) activates and fails the build on a single incomplete entry

features.title: Japanese colour atlas seed corpus
acceptance: Seed corpus published with 100 percent complete provenance and a named reviewer per entry
Contemporary palette systems: Quiet Neutrals, Indigo Studies, Forest and Mineral, Earth and Clay, Seasonal
Every palette has an anchor role and editorial provenance
Every source appears in the register in docs/content/licensing-and-provenance.md
No entry derives from a scraped or unlicensed dataset
features.notes: Blocked until OQ-4 (seed size: verified depth over breadth) and OQ-5 (Japanese editorial reviewer) close as ADRs.

features.title: Colour naming engine
acceptance: Returns at least 3 ranked candidates with DeltaE00 and a similarity percentage
Two-stage retrieval: coarse Lab-bucket shortlist, then exact DeltaE00 ranking in the engine
A test brute-forces the full corpus and asserts the two-stage result is identical
Output language is closest digital reference, never an assertion of identity; enforced by the claims lint

features.title: Harmony engine
acceptance: Monochromatic, tonal, analogous, complementary, split, triadic, tetradic, neutral, near-neutral, warm/cool, value-contrast and chroma-contrast generators
All generation happens in OKLCh, not HSL
Editorial Japanese harmonies sourced from the corpus, kept distinct from geometric ones
Every generated colour passes gamut mapping before it is returned

features.title: API foundation
acceptance: Fastify 5 with Zod schemas generating the OpenAPI document at build time
Every route declares schemas for params, query, body and every response status
Closed error-code enum; no internal detail ever serialised to a client
Idempotency-Key required on every non-idempotent mutation
Cursor pagination with hard limits
Rate limiting per IP and per identifier on auth routes
/healthz and /readyz behave per the deployment contract
Gate 7 (e2e) activates

features.title: Catalog read API and caching
acceptance: GET /v1/colors, /colors/{slug}, /palettes, /palettes/{slug}, /search
Immutable cache headers with the corpus version and the locale in the cache key
A corpus publish mints a new version rather than invalidating; a half-updated catalog is not servable
Postgres FTS plus pg_trgm for text; perceptual ranking in the engine, never in SQL

features.title: Web foundation: design system, accessibility, i18n
acceptance: Next.js 16 App Router, React 19, Tailwind v4 consuming @irodora/design-tokens, Radix primitives
Server Components by default; the colour engine loads only on routes that use it
Enumerated en/ja message catalogue; a missing translation fails the build
Japanese line-height scale and kinsoku line breaking verified; font fallback covers every kanji in the corpus
Zero axe WCAG 2.2 A/AA violations on every route
Gates 8 (a11y) and 13 (web-perf) activate

features.title: Web Colour Atlas and colour detail
acceptance: Every corpus entry reachable in 3 interactions or fewer from the atlas root
Server-rendered and statically generated per corpus version; indexable
The Atlas bundle contains no colour engine code
Colour detail shows names in four forms, every coordinate system, provenance, relations, palettes and CVD appearance
Every swatch has an accessible name and its numeric value

features.title: Web Colour Compare
acceptance: DeltaE00, per-axis differences, OKLCh delta, CVD separation and contrast, each with its units and computation space
Tabular numerals, aligned columns, copyable values

features.title: Palette Studio
acceptance: Build, edit, reorder and save palettes with anchor, neutral, light and accent roles
Palettes validate against the same schema as corpus palettes

features.title: Colour Finder
acceptance: Search by English name, Japanese name, kanji, romaji, hex, or natural phrase
A hex query returns its nearest entries by DeltaE00
Natural phrases map deterministically to lightness/chroma/hue regions from a versioned lexicon in content/rules

features.title: Web Colour Lens
acceptance: getUserMedia into an OffscreenCanvas with an explicit colour space
Live pick sustains 15 or more updates per second on the reference set
Precision pick samples 1000 or more pixels on a jittered grid, rejects specular highlights, extreme shadows and chromatic outliers, and averages in linear light
Returns median, trimmed mean, variance and confidence
Illumination class and capture quality shown BEFORE the colour value
Poor quality blocks a confident claim and returns a specific instruction
An e2e network assertion proves no image bytes are transmitted

features.title: Shareable colour cards
acceptance: A rendered card with name, kanji, hex, attribution and corpus version
Renders identically server-side and client-side
Readable at thumbnail size

features.title: Local-only mode and the offline engine
acceptance: Lens, atlas, harmony, compare and a local wardrobe work signed-out
An e2e run with the network disabled completes journeys J1 and J4
No account prompt blocks any core journey

features.title: Claims copy lint
acceptance: Banned constructions fail lint across UI strings, marketing copy, documentation, code comments and identifiers
Permissible language is bound to Provenance.source
The allowlist is explicit, small, and each entry links to the measurement supporting it
A deliberately added banned phrase makes the gate fail

features.title: Guided personal colour profile setup
acceptance: Swatch-comparison flow completes in 90 seconds median, with no camera
Produces lightness range, temperature tendency, chroma tolerance, contrast preference, neutrals, accents and avoid-list, each with its own confidence
The data model has no single skin-colour field, and a schema check rejects a migration adding one
Every dimension is editable, and a user correction is never overwritten by re-derivation

features.title: Photo-assisted profile setup
acceptance: Ranges derived on-device; the image is discarded and never transmitted
Every derived dimension presented as editable with its confidence
The profile is never finalised without explicit user confirmation
Bias validation across every ITA-degree band with a stated minimum sample per band

features.title: Personal compatibility engine
acceptance: Score in [0,100] as a pure function of profile and colour, given the rule version
Explanation objects are data: factor, contribution, direction, and an i18n message key
Per-dimension confidence weights the contribution of uncertain dimensions
No prose is generated at scoring time

features.title: Rule and weight content system
acceptance: Weights and harmony rules are versioned, immutable content in content/rules
Every rule carries a rationale; a weight without one cannot be published
Weights sum to 1.0, validated at publish time
Changing a weight changes rankings with no deployment
Occasion contexts are deterministic weighting profiles

features.title: Outfit colour engine
acceptance: Given a garment colour and slot, returns 5 or more ranked trouser and 4 or more ranked shoe candidates
At least three alternatives per recommendation, each labelled with the dimension it moves along
Candidate generation is bounded before scoring
Recommendation p95 within NFR-4

features.title: Outfit scoring and explainability
acceptance: Colour harmony, personal fit, contrast, Japanese aesthetic, versatility and CVD accessibility scored separately, plus an overall
All component scores are shown; the overall never replaces them
Every score returns its factor decomposition with direction and magnitude

features.title: CVD outfit mode
acceptance: Flags reduced separation and proposes an alternative with the measured improvement
The improvement is reproducible from the stored envelope
Reads as an observation about the outfit, not as a diagnosis of the user
Permanently available in the free tier

features.title: Authentication and account management
acceptance: OIDC, passkeys, Apple and Google; no password primitive exists in our code
Refresh token rotation with reuse detection; a replayed token revokes the family
Session revocation takes effect within 60 seconds across devices
Local-only mode remains fully functional signed-out
features.notes: Blocked until OQ-1 (self-hosted vs managed OIDC provider) closes as an ADR.

features.title: Multi-tenancy and row-level security
acceptance: tenant to organization to workspace to membership hierarchy in the schema
Every user-data table has tenant_id NOT NULL with RLS ENABLE and FORCE
irodora.tenant_id is set per connection from the session, never from a request field
A missing setting raises rather than returning rows
A negative test with a POPULATED decoy tenant proves cross-tenant reads return nothing
404, never 403, for another tenant's resource

features.title: Data subject rights: export and erasure
acceptance: POST /v1/me/export produces a machine-readable archive of every personal record
DELETE /v1/me hard-deletes AND de-indexes: database, blob storage, search index, cache, sync tombstones
A re-query against each store returns nothing; the job's exit code is not the proof
Both complete well within 30 days

features.title: Observability baseline
acceptance: OpenTelemetry traces, metrics and structured logs across api, worker and web, exported over OTLP
Image buffers and profile dimensions are carried in types with no serialiser; passing one to a log or span attribute is a type error
A redaction test attempts to reach a sink from every path holding such data and fails the build if any succeeds
Measurement outcomes are recorded instead of measurement inputs

features.title: Ethical guardrails and bias validation
acceptance: A schema check rejects any migration adding a skin-colour, ethnicity, age or health field
No code path infers a protected characteristic
Held-out validation set stratified by ITA-degree band, every band above its minimum sample
Per-band accuracy published internally; a band that underperforms blocks release of the profile feature
features.notes: A release blocker, not a nice-to-have. A personal-colour engine unvalidated across the full skin-tone range is not shippable.

features.title: Performance budgets and gates
acceptance: Absolute committed thresholds, never baseline deltas
Backend bench boots the real runtime over a versioned deterministic corpus
Frontend measured over the wire, gzipped, at the load event, under prefers-reduced-motion with CPU throttling, median of 3
Each gate self-tests its own arithmetic every run
Gates 12 (perf) and 13 (web-perf) activate

features.title: Mobile foundation: Expo development client
acceptance: Expo SDK 57 with a development client and the New Architecture
ios/ and android/ are generated and gitignored; native config lives in app.config.ts and plugins
EAS Build produces installable builds from a Windows workstation
The shared colour engine is imported, never ported

features.title: Mobile Colour Lens
acceptance: VisionCamera frame processors on a worklet thread; the UI thread never blocks on colour maths
yuv pixel format with conversion in the processor; every frame explicitly disposed
Capture colour space is read, never assumed; unknown caps the confidence
Only a small numeric result crosses the bridge; frames are discarded
All four capture modes

features.title: Offline local storage
acceptance: SQLite on mobile and IndexedDB on web behind one repository interface with a shared conformance suite
Writes succeed offline and survive restart; reads never block on network
Tokens and keys in SecureStore, never the app database

features.title: Wardrobe model, API and image encryption
acceptance: Only colour and type required at creation; every other field progressively enriched
Colour grouping uses perceptual distance, not hex string sorting
Wardrobe images under envelope encryption with per-tenant data keys; key rotation exercised in a test
EXIF stripped on ingest; images decoded only in the worker under hard limits
No documentation or copy describes this as end-to-end encryption

features.title: Add-garment flows
acceptance: Camera, Lens scan, manual colour and image upload
Median time to add an item 20 seconds or less, measured on device
Never more than two required fields

features.title: Sync protocol
acceptance: Field-level change records with per-field logical clocks; wall-clock time is advisory only
Deterministic tiebreak so every device converges to the SAME state
Typed merge rules: wear_count sums, outfit items union, preference weights merge and renormalise, deletion beats update
Push and pull in one round trip; idempotent on changeId
A property test applies a random permutation of a change set and asserts an identical final state
Tombstones retained 90 days; a device offline longer is forced to full resync
Gate 14 (e2e-full) activates

features.title: Outfit builder
acceptance: Compose slots, lock items, swap colours, regenerate
The same locked set and versions always regenerate the same candidates

features.title: Preference feedback loop
acceptance: Repeated selection shifts a stored, inspectable per-user weight
The user can see and reset it
No model training; feedback affects only the submitting user, never global ranking

features.title: Availability and graceful degradation
acceptance: A 503 from the API causes the client to fall back entirely to the local engine
Degraded-mode success rate measured and 95 percent or better
The fallback path is exercised in e2e-full, not assumed

features.title: Wardrobe coverage and gap analysis
acceptance: Reports valid outfit count and outfits per garment; recomputes incrementally on change
Gaps named in product language with the outfits they would unlock

features.title: Duplicate detection
acceptance: Flags items within DeltaE00 5 in the same category, showing the measured difference

features.title: Capsule optimiser
acceptance: Solves at least N outfits from at most M garments for a 40-item wardrobe within NFR-4
Branch-and-bound with a heuristic seed and a hard time budget
Returns best-so-far on expiry; the result is deterministic and reproducible

features.title: Cost-per-wear
acceptance: Computed from cost and recorded wears; absent data yields unknown, never an invented estimate

features.title: Shopping check
acceptance: Outfits unlocked, personal compatibility and duplicate warning, computed against the local wardrobe offline

features.title: Calibrated scan and reference card
acceptance: Detects the card, locates patches, solves a correction from observed to known values
Mean DeltaE00 improves by 50 percent or more against uncalibrated on the device matrix
The result is labelled calibrated; the correction matrix and its residual are stored for audit

features.title: Outfit scanner
acceptance: Estimates per-garment colours with confidence and returns the full score set
Classical CV only, with manual region override always available

features.title: Professional workspace
acceptance: Lab and LCh shown by default, not only swatches
Accepts colorimeter values, marking the resulting profile reference
Reference libraries, batch compare, calibration workflow

features.title: Exports and PDF reports
acceptance: CSV, JSON, CSS custom properties, ASE, design tokens and PDF
Every export embeds the engine and corpus versions
ASE round-trips through Adobe tooling
A report is reproducible from its envelope

features.title: Public API, keys and quotas
acceptance: OpenAPI generated from the implementation, never hand-written
@irodora/sdk generated from OpenAPI and consumed by our own clients
API keys with scopes; quota exhaustion returns a documented error with a reset time
Usage metering is auditable

features.title: Billing and entitlements
acceptance: Free, Pro, Studio and API tiers with server-side entitlement enforcement
A test proves a client cannot unlock a tier feature
Accessibility features are unconditionally in the free tier

features.title: Audit trail
acceptance: Append-only; the application role has no UPDATE or DELETE grant
Every corpus publish, entitlement change and role change queryable with actor, time and before/after
Chronological only; no user-facing column sorting

features.title: Scale and load validation
acceptance: 100k corpus entries, 10k wardrobe items per user, 1000 rps catalog reads sustained within NFR-4
Origin-to-edge request ratio measured; a rise signals a broken cache key

features.title: Admin content application
acceptance: Colours, palettes, translations, rules, sources and licences managed here
No corpus change is possible outside this application in production
Every publish is audit-logged with actor and diff

features.title: Editorial review workflow
acceptance: draft to review to verified to published to superseded
An entry cannot reach published without a recorded reviewer distinct from the author
A published entry is never edited; corrections publish a new version

features.title: Device colour lab
acceptance: Controlled measurement across the reference device matrix, all modes, all illuminants, 10 or more repeats per combination
Published table of mean and p95 DeltaE00 per device, mode and lighting condition
Reported confidence is correlated with measured accuracy
No accuracy number is published without a row in this table

features.title: Pattern and multi-colour extraction
acceptance: Ranked primary, secondary and accent colours with area proportions
Meets its accuracy target on the pattern test corpus for stripes, checks, colour blocks and prints

features.title: Occasion and weather context
acceptance: Occasion and weather are deterministic weighting profiles in versioned content
Weather is an optional input; the recommendation is unchanged and complete without it

features.title: Team workspaces
acceptance: Roles and shared palette libraries within a workspace
Role changes take effect immediately and are audit-logged
